units: 1 = 1 map tile; stands on y = 0 at the origin, faces +z; place at scale 1; one voxel = 0.04

apprentice.note: The hand-built hero of Hero-pixel.blend, rebuilt cell for cell from the template (the reference model)

orrin.note: Archmage Orrin Vael: tall, slate-blue robe and pointed hat, long white beard, staff with a gold crystal (Staff_glow)

hesper.note: Hesper Marrow, hedge-witch: moss dress, cream apron, rust shawl, slouch hat with a rosehip sprig, grey bun

pell.note: Pell, the apprentice's young cousin: mustard tunic, red scarf, curly hair, satchel

marta.note: Marta Fenn, well-keeper: blue dress, kerchief, braids, a bucket in her left hand

abel.note: Abel Crane, miller: heavy-set, floury apron, flat cap, ginger beard, ledger under his arm

rowan.note: Rowan Tull, shepherd: brown wool cloak with the hood down, green tunic, crook

odile.note: Reeve Odile Marsh: long wine-red coat, gold chain of office, auburn bun, glasses

gale.note: Gale Harrow, grain-warden: leather jerkin, straw hat, grey beard, tally slate in the left hand

sefa.note: Sefa, the Hollow who doubts: grey hooded cloak with a face you can see (young, unsure)

hollow.note: A Hollow: ragged grey hooded robe, an empty dark hood, sleeves ending in shadow; glides, no feet

morvane.note: Morvane the Hollow, once a Warden: tall and pale, charcoal robe with broken gold Measure lines, a tattered midnight mantle, a hollow rune on his chest (Rune_glow)

taddeus.note: Taddeus Quill, Keeper of the Great Scales (Riverholm): teal robe with bronze trim, scholar's cap, round glasses, goatee, a quill behind his ear

ilsabet.note: Ilsabet Thorne, the Ringwarden (Greystone): tall, slate robe with silver trim, plum sash, silver circlet, black bun with a white streak, a staff topped with a ring

wenna.note: Old Wenna Ashgrove, seer of the Bonelands: small, bone-white dress with a hoodoo-striped hem, dusk-red shawl, long white hair, bone necklace, a stick with a bone charm

roan.note: Captain Roan Ashby of the river watch: teal-blue coat with bronze buttons, kettle helmet, brown beard, tall boots, a boat-hook

hero.note: The tinted villager and apprentice: slot meshes coloured from the look (Pack.dress), six hair styles, cloak, belt and pouch

hero_f.note: Witch apprentice (female body): tinted skin and six hair styles; earned farm clothes, robes and pointed hats

hero_m.note: Wizard apprentice (male body): tinted skin and six hair styles; earned farm clothes, robes and pointed hats

sheep.note: A ewe: cream wool, dark face and legs

lamb.note: A lamb: white wool, pink face

hen.note: A white hen: red comb and wattle, yellow beak and legs

dog.note: A sheepdog: black and white, ears up, white-tipped tail

cat.note: The familiar: a small black cat with gold eyes, tail up
